reasons.REGISTRY_CONFLICT: The registry and student identity disagree, or prior history needs review.
reasons.UNVERIFIED_GAP: No current holder was observed. Internal and external history still require verification.
reasons.CONFIRMED_AVAILABLE: An administrator explicitly verified that this code was never assigned.

reasons.RESERVATION_HELD: An operation holds this code; it cannot be recovered or reused.
